research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Sysdig is researching unified event processing and log management over multiple domains, focusing on receiving streaming event data from cloud managers and applications. They are also developing runtime filtering of computer system vulnerabilities, identifying and remediating active vulnerabilities in currently running assets. Additionally, Sysdig is advancing programmatic container monitoring by storing trace data in shared memory buffers between kernel and user space. These areas reflect their focus on cloud security powered by runtime insights.

overview_description.description:
In the cloud, every second counts. Attacks move at warp speed, and security teams must protect the business without slowing it down. Sysdig stops cloud attacks in real time, instantly detecting changes in risk with runtime insights, a unique AI architecture, and open source Falco. Sysdig delivers live visibility by correlating signals across cloud workloads, identities, and services to uncover hidden attack paths. By knowing what is running, teams can prioritize the vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, permissions, and threats that matter most. From prevention to defense, Sysdig helps enterprises move faster and focus on what matters: innovation.

Sysdig. Secure Every Second.

about_short_description.short_description: Sysdig is a cyber security company that offers a platform for detecting changes in risk with runtime insights to prevent cloud attacks.

product.name: Sysdig Secure
product.description: A cloud-native application protection platform (CNAPP) for securing cloud infrastructure, workloads, containers, Kubernetes, and applications across the development and runtime lifecycle.

product.name: Sysdig Monitor
product.description: A cloud-native monitoring and observability platform for viewing application, infrastructure, container, Kubernetes, and cloud-service performance and health.

product.name: Sysdig Headless Cloud Security
product.description: An agent-based cloud security interface that embeds Sysdig security capabilities into AI coding platforms and enables programmable security workflows without a dashboard.

product.name: Sysdig Sage
product.description: A generative AI cloud security analyst that uses multi-step reasoning to help investigate findings, explain risk, and guide security actions.

product.name: Falco
product.description: An open-source runtime security engine for detecting suspicious behavior and threats in Linux, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud-native environments.

product.name: Falco Feeds by Sysdig
product.description: A collection of enterprise detection rules for Falco that identifies current cloud-native attack behaviors and maps detections to security frameworks.
